summary: E-Rate Advocacy urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband connectivity for schools and libraries. The comment expresses opposition to sunsetting the E-Rate program, citing budgetary concerns and the need to preserve funding for schools and libraries. It emphasizes the importance of E-Rate in providing affordable connectivity for educational institutions and urges the FCC to reject any proposal to reduce or eliminate the program.
